action_semantics.link_up: Set an administratively down interface UP; restores a link_down fault on that interface.
action_semantics.route_replace: Restore the intended gateway for route_missing/route_wrong, or a measured absent route whose gateway lies in an interface subnet restored by address_add or link_up in the same plan.

findings.explanation: Measured address differs from intent; dependent route absence is retained as evidence, not a separate root cause.
Measured administrative link state is down; dependent route absence is retained as consequence evidence.
Measured route differs from declared routing intent.

diagnosis.summary: Hybrid model proposal and deterministic public intent/state confirmation within the declared local fault scope.

task.execution_boundary: Owned isolated research lab only; captured-state rollback and independent checks are required.

intent.scope: IPv4 static routing and packet filtering; no DNS/OSPF/BGP services

task.task: Assess the evidence and explain your decision before setting approved. Independently decide whether this proposed configuration repair is justified. Approve only when every action restores the declared intended state of an evidence-backed fault on the same device and target, with no unrelated changes. Reject an empty or incomplete plan, unsupported evidence, a wrong device/target/value, or an action that introduces a fault. A permitted restorative change is not disruptive merely because it changes configuration. Do not require physical hardware failure evidence: link_down means measured administrative state is down. Use the action semantics below and cite measured evidence IDs. Policy, twin equivalence, recovery and regression checks remain mandatory after your decision; your approval alone never authorizes execution.
